goal: Close the production false-pass recovery loop at integration and pre-public checkpoints without adding a supervisor, pipeline, or Provider scheduler.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence false-pass findings invoke no Provider and rerun the corresponding canonical evidence before re-audit.
Kernel false-pass findings invoke governed kernel repair, require regression PASS, and then re-audit.
Production recovery cases A through E, focused verification, and quick verification pass.
Production retains exactly one ProviderJob scheduler and ordinary Provider failures invoke zero Codex calls.
Project false-pass findings invoke only the existing Provider leaf execution route for affected repair scope before validation and re-audit.
User-decision and halt routes terminate explicitly, while two consecutive audit refusals become NEEDS_REWORK.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: production false-pass recovery completion and invocation isolation
quality_metrics.target: A-C automatically recover and resume, D stops after two refusals, E invokes zero Codex, and only one production ProviderJob scheduler remains
quality_metrics.method: production consumer fault injection, route consumption inspection, governed repair isolation, invocation counters, quick profile, and bounded call-graph guards

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: scripts/codex_conversation.py consumes only receipts emitted by scripts/cgkn_supervision_router.py and re-emits the same positive checkpoint after recovery.
scripts/run_local_pipeline_impl.py translates project audit targets into the existing pending repair plan and remains the only ProviderJob worker-pool owner.
Evidence recheck never invokes Provider, governed kernel repair never writes customer candidates, and local_packager remains the only delivery exit.

feedback: Production routes now auto-consume, recover through the existing authority-correct path, re-emit, and re-audit; live Qwen remains transport-blocked.

worked: One deterministic receipt consumer closed integration and pre-public recovery without another supervisor, pipeline, or scheduler.
did_not_work: The first quick run exposed an over-narrow evidence invalidation role and stale support-lane tests patching duplicate module instances; both were corrected and the full quick profile passed on rerun.
experiments: On the next credentialed Provider run, inject one audited leaf-level contradiction and measure affected-only Provider calls plus checkpoint reuse.
